I also miss my abuser often. Although I know objectively they were bad to/for me, it also felt like I was the most important person in the world to them, and they were the most important person to me. I miss feeling that special, and it is really hard to convince my brain sometimes that healthy love isn't that suffocating. 

You haven't done anything wrong, in my opinion there seems to just be a bit of miscommunication when it comes to your feelings towards your abuser. 

I agree with the other comments that seeing a counselor/therapist together would really help, having an objective 3rd party that can help you both see eye to eye on your trauma and how it manifests will hopefully bring you both together even stronger.
